title: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel

sources.title: Illusion Quickening
markers: | summary = '''Illusion Quickening''' is a passive feature that lets the wearer cast illusion or enchantment spells after making a weapon attack.

summary: After a weapon hit, use a Bonus Action to cast Illusion or Enchantment spells and eligible scrolls for the rest of the turn.

fields.Use: After a weapon hit, cast Illusion and Enchantment spells only as a Bonus Action for the rest of the turn. Other schools retain their regular casting costs.
fields.Timing and scrolls: Quickening expires at the start of your turn. An opportunity attack does not carry it into your next turn. Eligible scrolls and the Disguise Kit qualify.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and pinned evidence, then refined its mechanics against item and linked rule notes.
